israel.question: Israel or Palestine?
israel.headline: Leans Palestine
israel.headlineWhy: The headline names the side that most items on this card point to, and says “leans” when some items point elsewhere. Here 5 items point toward Palestine, 0 toward Israel and 1 are mixed.
israel.summary: He voted for every resolution on this card that would block arms sales to Israel or require reports on its human rights record. He led the NDAA push to drop provisions on U.S.-Israel defense cooperation, and in statements he mourned the October 7 victims and called for accountability for violence in the West Bank.

items.t: Voted Yea on both of Sen. Sanders's April 2025 resolutions to block arms sales to Israel. Both failed.
Voted Yea on both July 2025 resolutions to block weapons sales and exports to Israel. Both failed.
Voted Yea on both April 2026 resolutions to block arms sales to Israel. Both failed.
Voted Yea to force a State Department report on Israel's human rights practices (S.Res. 852). It failed 47–51; the Democratic caucus voted 46–1.
After the vote on his privileged resolution on West Bank violence, said nine American citizens have been killed in recent years without accountability.
On the third anniversary of the October 7 attacks, remembered the hundreds of lives lost and the hostages, and said civilians in Gaza bear a staggering daily toll.
